capabilities: Create character sheets with a wizard and templates
Render healthbar, ability, skills, features, spells, and inventory widgets in code blocks
Track level-ups, feature uses, spell slots, and gold via frontmatter properties
Define custom homebrew rulebooks as JSON files in the vault
Apply custom rules blocks such as Critical Role's Desperate Measures
disambiguation: Not a Player's Handbook replacement or rules reference; it only surfaces character-relevant data and expects players to consult the handbook.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation covers data structures in detail but contains numerous typos and no troubleshooting section.
intentEvidence: I would have never gone through the trouble of making my own plugin to expand upon it
motivation: The author wanted a comfortable character sheet in Obsidian and was inspired by hay-kot's Obsidian DnD UI Toolkit to build his own plugin expanding on it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, display, or manage an interactive D&D character sheet with rules data inside notes.

relations.evidence: was the inspiration for the color pallete and the reason I started this project

summary: Renders D&D 5e (2024) character sheet widgets in notes — health, abilities, skills, spells, inventory — with a creation wizard and JSON homebrew rulebooks.
